builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Seraphine: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (3,696 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on Lolalytics, patch 16.20, 54% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A team-oriented ranged mage who sequences echoes, combines control with allied effects and consumes notes through a ranged attack. Grouping amplifies her shielding and ultimate reach. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Zaz'Zak's Realmspike → Echoes of Helia → Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Arcane Comet keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Moonstone Renewer, Redemption, Diadem of Songs.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Zaz'Zak's Realmspike → Echoes of Helia → Ionian Boots of Lucidity, with Arcane Comet.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Zaz'Zak's Realmspike → Echoes of Helia → Ionian Boots of Lucidity) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 54% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Zaz'Zak's Realmspike → Echoes of Helia → Ionian Boots of Lucidity.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: Lolalytics ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them [(0.2 + (0.0002) × AP) × (0.4)] Move Speed, herself [0.2 + (0.0002) × AP] decaying Move Speed and both [(60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 + (0.2) × AP) × (1)] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring [8 / 10 / 12 / 14 / 16]% missing Health to them after a [2.5] second delay.

Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by [99]% for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds.

Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned.

Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to [(60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.4) × AP) × (1.75)] damage below [25]% Health.

Every third basic Ability Seraphine casts will echo, automatically casting a second time.

Additionally, Seraphine draws inspiration from the music within her allies, creating a Note for each nearby ally whenever she casts an Ability. For each Note, Seraphine's Attacks gain [25] Attack Range and deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(4 → 25; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AP] magic damage and consume the Notes.

Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75] seconds and deals [150 / 200 / 250 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.

builds.name: Notes attack mage
builds.summary: Test notes attack mage against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test notes attack mage against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Stage Presence adds 25 attack range and AP-scaled magic damage per note; casting near allies and hitting Encore through them prepares a long-range empowered attack. Nashor supports subsequent attacks and Lich Bane adds one spell-triggered magic packet, but notes are consumed on the first attack.
testPlan: Required state: Several allies near casts and notes banked before attacking.
Compare first note attack and subsequent two attacks separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: After note consumption she loses that temporary range and becomes exposed.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Every attack does not retain maximum notes or permanently extended range.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Tempo and pursuit
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Seraphine: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A team-oriented ranged mage who sequences echoes, combines control with allied effects and consumes notes through a ranged attack. Grouping amplifies her shielding and ultimate reach. Record Echo readiness, ally notes and pre-existing slows/roots for E upgrades. Grouped shielding/R reach cannot be assumed during a solo-target damage test. Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
builds.summary: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
testPlan: Kit question for Seraphine: Record Echo readiness, ally notes and pre-existing slows/roots for E upgrades. Grouped shielding/R reach cannot be assumed during a solo-target damage test.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Seraphine deals damage in an area. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.

The route fails Seraphine's stated kit question: Record Echo readiness, ally notes and pre-existing slows/roots for E upgrades. Grouped shielding/R reach cannot be assumed during a solo-target damage test.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Imperial Mandate, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Slow-to-stun charge support
builds.summary: Test slow-to-stun charge support against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test slow-to-stun charge support against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Beat Drop upgrades slow to root and immobilization to stun; Rylai tests providing a slow on the damage event, while echoed E offers a second hit. Helia stores damage and WW shielding consumes it for healing; Mandate benefits confirmed immobilizations rather than arbitrary slows.
testPlan: Required state: Echo E available and allies remain inside Surround Sound.
Compare single E, echoed E and pre-slowed E, then measure WW healing.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Rylai processing order might not upgrade a single E; weak AP reduces damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rylai's same-hit status ordering needs testing instead of assuming unconditional single-cast root.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
